mainEntity.name: What is a typical functional fitness training session like at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical functional fitness training session at Cave Training begins with a dynamic warm-up to prepare your body for movement, focusing on mobility and activation. The main workout will then involve a series of compound exercises targeting different movement patterns, often incorporating bodyweight, free weights, or other equipment. Sessions conclude with a cool-down and stretching to aid recovery. Our coaches ensure proper form and can modify exercises to match your fitness level throughout the session.
